decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records integration of suitable bowl LEDs that are electrically compatible with the setup; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures bowl accent lighting, compatible LED selection, and its social-media visual purpose.
Selecting suitable LEDs for the BOM does not necessarily change the current finalized-system-layout deliverable or establish a new CAD attribute.
The LED selection is compatible with the existing component strategy and does not replace or modify the current off-the-shelf strategy.
The LED selection has no necessary effect on whisk size, material, style, powder compatibility, or positioning.
Adding compatible accent LEDs around the bowls does not establish any change to bowl-removal clearance or swapping behavior.
The source decision concerns LED selection and does not alter bowl capacity, form, or the approved 2.5-quart selection.
The LED selection does not change dispensing flow, froth preservation, pour direction, or valve sequencing.
The source decision does not modify cleaning, sanitation, component removal, or hidden-liquid-trap requirements.
Selecting suitable LEDs does not alter liquid containment, valve dripping, plumbing seals, or liquid-electrical separation.
The client requires LEDs compatible with the existing setup but does not change the 120V architecture, 50A supply, controller capacity, or power-margin requirements.
The compatible-LED selection does not establish a new continuous-operation or electrical-load-capacity requirement.
